About this data
cards.text: Source: Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics (BITRE), Australian Road Deaths Database. Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia. This is a derived snapshot: columns were selected and renamed, records filtered to 2019 onward, and the most recent 4,000 retained. Full transformation list is in the manifest. Aggregate incident data with no personal identifiers, so the privacy filter finds nothing in it — which is the honest half of the contrast against the synthetic fixtures, where it finds everything.
